id.description: Id for the store. Not currently used by the point cloud scene layer.

profile.description: Defines the profile type of the scene layer as point cloud scene layer. Must be: `PointCloud`

version.description: Point cloud scene layer store version.

extent.description: 2D extent of the point cloud scene layer in the layers spatial reference units.

index.description: Describes the index (i.e. bounding volume tree) of the layer.

geometryEncoding.description: MIME type for the encoding used for the Geometry Resources. For example: application/octet-stream; version=1.6.

attributeEncoding.description: MIME type for the encoding used for the Attribute Resources. For example: application/octet-stream; version=1.6.
